source_title: Germany Business Confidence Rises For 6th Month As Government Spending Fuels Economic Recovery Hopes - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Business confidence in Germany has risen for the sixth consecutive month, reaching its highest level since May 2023. Improving sentiment in construction and manufacturing, expanding order books and increased government spending are fuelling hopes of an economic recovery. But economists remain cautious as private investment stays weak, companies continue cutting jobs and households struggle with high living and energy costs.#Germany #GermanEconomy #BusinessConfidence #EconomicRecovery #EuropeanEconomy #Manufacturing #Construction #InfrastructureSpending #CostOfLiving #EnergyPrices #GermanyNews #EuropeNews #BusinessNews #WorldNews #DWNews
